summary.text: Garrett Bascom is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 68, which he has represented since November 2024, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Hunter Collins as his opponent in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Garrett Bascom graduated from South Dearborn High School and earned a bachelor's degree in communication and new media studies from Mount St. Joseph University.
He received a law degree from Indiana University's Robert H. McKinney School of Law in 2020.
His career experience includes working as an attorney at Bascom & Kisor LLC, serving in the Attorney General's Office, and working as a deputy prosecutor for Dearborn County and Ohio County.
Bascom won the seat in 2024, succeeding Randy Lyness, with 79.5 percent of the vote over Democrat Lisa Barker.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him on the Courts and Criminal Code, House Judiciary and House Local Government committees.
